story.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli: Mercedes driver hailed by pundits and Toto Wolff after remarkable 19th to first Italian GP comeback win
story.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli produced a remarkable comeback from 19th on the grid to win the Italian Grand Prix, earning praise from pundits and team boss Toto Wolff. He caught teammate George Russell to claim a landmark home victory and extend his championship lead.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利：这位梅赛德斯车手在第19位发车并完成惊人逆转赢得意大利大奖赛后，获得解说员和托托·沃尔夫的盛赞
尼科·罗斯伯格和马丁·布伦德尔谈基米·安东内利为梅赛德斯完成的惊人逆转，车队老板托托·沃尔夫解释了他认为促成这一差异的关键因素；从周五开始，在天空体育F1频道直播观看马德里新赛道的西班牙大奖赛的每一节练习、排位和正赛
基米·安东内利回顾他在蒙扎从第19位夺得第一的轰动性胜利，追赶队友乔治·拉塞尔，取得里程碑式的主场胜利，并扩大了自己在车手总冠军积分榜上的领先优势
在蒙扎的这个周末，排位赛已经诞生了一个令人难以置信的结果，而周日这场激动人心的比赛中，意大利的新生代年轻明星基米·安东内利又带来了第二个，确保这个周末在一级方程式的历史书中占据显赫的位置。
当然，与意外夺得杆位的皮埃尔·加斯利不同——他此前190次参赛大多驾驶中游赛车，从未在一级方程式的发车排位中排过头排——20岁的安东内利今年已经成为车阵前列的常客。
周日是这位梅赛德斯车手在越发令人印象深刻的第二个一级方程式赛季中的第七场分站冠军，这场胜利将他原本59分的积分榜领先优势扩大到66分，追平了本赛季的最高领先纪录。

安东内利从 F1 七十六年历史上倒数第二低的发车位置——第十九位——夺得冠军，并击败了从前排发车的队友兼主要争冠对手拉塞尔，因此这场胜利绝不仅仅是一场普通的胜利。
这还没算上本土因素——安东内利终结了意大利车手长达60年无法在家乡大奖赛夺冠的等待。
在蒙扎上演的惊人逆袭之后，安东内利被马丁·布伦德尔称为“基米国王”。布伦德尔四十多年来既与这项运动众多传奇人物同场竞技过，也解说过他们的比赛。
2026年意大利大奖赛精彩集锦
布伦德尔在天空体育F1的同事、2016年世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格，在目睹了安东内利出色的表现后，同样不吝赞美之词。
罗斯伯格说：“我们得说，他跑的这场比赛，第一圈，第二次起步，一切都堪称完美。”
“他所拥有的速度，以及他掌控一切的方式。你不可能做得更好了。”
“这只是他在F1的第二个赛季，他刚满20岁。有谁能做到这样？这简直闻所未闻！”
“他要在水面上行走了”——沃尔夫原以为可能出现一个“特别的时刻”。
罗斯伯格是赛前众多认为领奖台对安东内利来说基本无望的人之一，因为安东内利从发车区倒数第二排起步；这位意大利车手自己在排位赛后也曾排除了这种可能性。
但事实证明，并不是所有人都认为由于发车处罚导致安东内利排位如此靠后，这场比赛就必然只是一场纯粹止损的比赛。
“我当时认为两名梅赛德斯车手中会有一位赢下比赛，”梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫在赛后透露。
“要么是乔治，因为他在重新发车时处于杆位，要么是基米，因为他将要在蒙扎这里创造奇迹。而且我昨天也有这种感觉。”
基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛上多次上演史诗级的队友对决，争夺领先位置
沃尔夫曾与刘易斯·汉密尔顿在梅赛德斯共事，见证了这位英国人七夺世界冠军中的六次。他表示，他感觉到安东内利有望在自己的主场赛道迎来“一个特别的时刻”。
“我已经观察车手们的精力状态、心态和行为模式很久了，我知道他今天的目标就是赢下这场比赛，”他说。
“我昨天和他的父亲聊过，他父亲也预感到了这一点。
“正是在这些时刻，你可以通过各个练习环节看出一个周末的走势如何，预感到一个特别的时刻可能到来。
“这仍然是一项机械运动，所以情况可能很快就会发生变化。”
就像任何伟大的逆袭故事一样，安东内利的这场翻身仗也离不开一些好运的眷顾。
当然，因为勒克莱尔在第二圈发生严重撞车而触发红旗后进行的第二次发车，提供了一个比比赛不中断时更快追回多个名次的机会，尽管这也打乱了梅赛德斯原计划让安东内尔利用硬胎跑一个较长首段（阶段）的部署。
勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛中撞车退赛
当红旗出示时，他已经跑到了第12位。随后在比赛重启的那一圈，他又前进了四个名次。到第13圈时，他已经紧跟在第三位的拉塞尔身后，而当加斯利的早期挑战逐渐消退后，从第16圈开始，梅赛德斯的两辆赛车展开正面交锋，领先位置几乎每一圈都在不断易手。
最终随着争夺稍微平息，他跑在第二位，随后一次时机把握得当的虚拟安全车让安东内利得以进站，换上更晚使用的全新中性胎，而拉塞尔则基本注定要撑到比赛结束、使用磨损更严重的硬胎，不过沃尔夫表示，当时并不清楚哪种策略能赢得比赛。
无论如何，沃尔夫认为，真正起到决定性作用的是安东内利在赛道上超越其他赛车的表现。
“今天决定胜负的关键在于穿越车流的能力，”沃尔夫补充道，“我们过去在其他伟大车手身上也见过这一点。刘易斯在一些比赛中就做到过，而这正是他今天所展现出来的。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli: Mercedes driver hailed by pundits and Toto Wolff after remarkable 19th to first Italian GP comeback win

Nico Rosberg and Martin Brundle have their say on Kimi Antonelli's remarkable comeback drive as Mercedes' boss Toto Wolff explains what he felt made the difference; watch every session of the Spanish Grand Prix at a new track in Madrid from Friday, live on Sky Sports F1
Kimi Antonelli reflects on his sensational 19th-to-1st Monza victory, catching teammate George Russell to claim a landmark home win and strengthen his championship lead

On a Monza weekend that had already produced one implausible result in qualifying, Italy's new young star Kimi Antonelli delivered a second in Sunday's thrilling race to ensure its own prominent place in Formula 1's history books.

Of course, unlike surprise pole position sitter Pierre Gasly - who had never previously qualified at the head of an F1 grid in 190 appearances spent in mostly midfield cars - the 20-year-old Antonelli has become a fixture at the head of the field this year.

Sunday represented the seventh race win of the Mercedes driver's increasingly-impressive second of Formula 1 and one which extended what stood as a 59-point championship lead to a joint season-high 66 points.

But by winning from the second-lowest grid position in F1's 76-year history - 19th place - and beating a team-mate and chief title rival in George Russell who had started from the front row, Antonelli ensured it was anything but just another win.
And that's before you even consider the local factor too - Antonelli ended a 60-year wait for an Italian to win their home Grand Prix again.

The remarkable Monza comeback led to Antonelli being described as "King Kimi" by Martin Brundle, who has both raced against and commentated on many of the sport's most legendary figures over more than four decades.
Highlights from the 2026 Italian Grand Prix
Brundle's fellow Sky Sports F1 pundit Nico Rosberg, the 2016 world champion, was similarly effusive in his praise after witnessing Antonelli's remarkable drive.
"We have to say the race that he drove, the first lap, the second start, everything was to perfection," said Rosberg.
"The speed he had, how he was managing everything. You cannot do it better.
"He's in his second season in F1, he just turned 20. Who does that like that? It's just unheard of!"
'He's going to walk over water' - Wolff thought 'special moment' was possible

Rosberg had been among the many ahead of the race to suggest that a podium was likely out of Antonelli's reach from the grid's penultimate row, something the Italian himself had ruled out after qualifying.
But it turns out that not everyone was expecting it to necessarily be a race purely of damage limitation from the grid penalties that had left Antonelli so out of position.
"I thought one of the two [Mercedes drivers] is going to win," disclosed Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff after the race.
"Either George because he was on pole [for the restart] or Kimi because he's going to walk over water here in Monza. And I felt that yesterday also."
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell go wheel-to-wheel for the Italian Grand Prix lead in several epic team-mate battles
Wolff, who worked with Lewis Hamilton at Mercedes for six of the Briton's seven world titles, said he sensed "a special moment" was potentially in the offing from Antonelli at his home track.
"Its been a while that I've seen drivers' energy levels, mindset or behavioural pattern and I knew that that was his mission today, to win the race," he said.
"I chatted with his father yesterday, the father also saw that coming.
"These are the moments where you can see how a weekend is panning out through the sessions, that a special moment could come.
"It's still a mechanical sport, so it can change quickly."
Like any great comeback story, Antonelli's was not without some good fortune along the way.

Certainly, the second race start after the red flag for Charles Leclerc's big lap-two crash offered a second chance to make up multiple places more quickly than otherwise might have made the chance had the race not been stopped, even if it did compromise Mercedes' plans for running Antonelli on a long hard-tyre opening stint.
Charles Leclerc CRASHES OUT the of the Italian GP

He was already running 12th by the time the red flag was thrown. He then picked up four more places on the restart lap. By lap 13 he was directly behind Russell in third and, once Gasly's early challenge faded, the Mercedes' went head-to-head from lap 16 in what soon turned into an almost lap-by-lap changing of the lead.

Eventually running second as the battle settled down slightly, a later well-timed Virtual Safety Car then allowed Antonelli to make a pit stop to switch on to fresher medium tyres, with Russell soon locked in to going to the end on more-worn hards, although Wolff said it was not clear at the time which strategy would win the race.
In any case, Wolff believes it was Antonelli's driving on track overtaking cars that made the difference.

"The differentiator today was the ability going through the traffic," added Wolff. "We've seen it with other great ones in the past. Lewis put it in some of the races and that's what he's shown today.

勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."
Charles Leclerc says he's 'settled' feud with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton after their clash in last week's Mexico City GP

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their incident in Mexico
Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。
观看周六下午2:30的最终练习赛，晚上6点天空体育 F1将直播排位赛。
圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
